ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Shelvr lets you choose a photo from your library to use as a trip cover.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Shelvr saves images you share, like your Passport story, to your photos.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Shelvr adds events to your calendar from things you've saved.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Shelvr adds events to your calendar from things you've saved.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Shelvr shows where you are on the map so you can find the places you saved nearby.
